dct_description_sm: This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means [here](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tags) ) : tags['amenity'] IN ('kindergarten', 'school', 'college', 'university') OR tags['building'] IN ('kindergarten', 'school', 'college', 'university') Features may have these attributes: - [name](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name) - [name:en](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:en) - [amenity](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity) - [building](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:building) - [operator:type](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:operator:type) - [capacity:persons](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:capacity:persons) - [addr:full](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:addr:full) - [addr:city](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:addr:city) - [source](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:source) - [name:hr](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:hr) This dataset is one of many [OpenStreetMap exports on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot). See the [Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team](http://hotosm.org/) website for more information.
